caption: The drawing features a dark, solid silhouette of a rooster, oriented to the right, positioned prominently in the center of the composition. The rooster stands on one leg, while the other leg is slightly raised. The tail feathers curve upward and outward, creating a fan-like shape, and the head displays a distinct comb and beak. The silhouette is intersected and supported by three straight, dark bars arranged in a Y-shaped configuration, with a horizontal bar crossing near the lower end and a vertical bar extending downward. The entire composition is rendered on a light beige background, with a thin rectangular border surrounding the drawing. In the bottom right corner, the name "Rollington Campbell" appears in small, light script. In the lower left corner, there is a small scale for measurement with labeled increments. The illustration uses a monochromatic gray and black palette for the rooster and supporting bars, contrasting with the lighter background.
title: Weather Vane - Cock
